title: Server to devices: message
description: Messages are filtered by audience on the server. A device never receives a message it should not see.

cursor.description: Position in the session's message stream, opaque to devices. A reconnecting device sends the last cursor it saw and receives only what it missed.

text.description: Banner text: a few words. At most 120 characters.

detail.description: Optional second line under the banner: for a penalty, the catalog's explanation (what it means and how to respond). Views without room may leave it out.

showAt.description: Server clock time at which every device shows the message.

sticky.description: State messages (true) stay as a banner until superseded. One-off messages (false) show briefly and stay in the history.

createdBy.description: A steward (steward:<pseudonymous id>), a procedure (procedure:<id>) or the system.

session.description: iRacing session number and time, to match entries with the replay.

supersedes.description: Ids of earlier messages this one replaces: a device removes them from its banners. Used when a state ends (green after a caution) or a penalty is revoked.
